title: Algophony Score Record
description: Schema for benchmark scores of a generated soundscape.

prompt_adherence.description: How well the output matches the prompt. 1=mostly ignores, 5=fully follows.

source_accuracy.description: Accuracy of sound sources relative to prompt expectations.

spatial_coherence.description: Plausibility of spatial positioning and depth layering.

event_density_score.description: Appropriateness of event density for the described scene.

ecological_plausibility.description: Whether sources could plausibly coexist. 1=incoherent, 5=strong habitat logic.

false_source_index.description: Degree of false or forbidden sources. 0=none, 5=dominant false sources.

generic_naturalism_index.description: Degree of generic birds/water/wind naturalism. 0=none, 5=fully generic.

cultural_cliche_index.description: Degree of stereotyped cultural representation. 0=none, 5=strong cliché.
